$comment: D-PP-PREDEFINE-REDEFINITION-PARTITION: runtime witness that a program's '#define'/'#undef' of a name this implementation predefined ALWAYS TAKES EFFECT, and that only the DIAGNOSTIC is partitioned. C23 6.10.10.1p2 says such a name 'shall not be the subject of a #define or a #undef' -- but 6.10.10 carries NO 'Constraints' heading (6.10.5 Macro replacement does), so C23 4p2 makes the violation UNDEFINED BEHAVIOUR and 5.1.1.3 requires a diagnostic only for a syntax-rule or CONSTRAINT violation. Nothing is required. DSS previously refused every case as a hard error. ★★ THE REFERENCE DIFFERENTIAL, run on THIS FILE: ✔MEASURED 2026-08-26, gcc 13.3.0 (-Wall -std=c17) and clang 18.1.3 (-Wall -std=c23) probed SEPARATELY, compiling this exact main.c -- BOTH emit exactly 2 warnings, at the SAME line:column (the two '#undef's of the warn-class names), and BOTH exit 255. DSS emits 2 warnings at the same line:column and exits 255. Same count, same positions, same exit code, three compilers. ★ Note check (1) is '__STDC_VERSION__ > 0' and not '>= 202311L' on purpose: gcc 13.3 reports 202000L even under -std=c2x, so a final-C23 literal would score 254 on gcc for a reason unrelated to the subject, and an arm that diverges on an unrelated axis is an arm that will be misread. ★ EVERY OTHER VALUE IS DERIVED FROM THE MACRO'S OWN ORIGINAL (+7, +76, +1000) rather than written as a literal -- a literal can pass for the wrong reason on a target whose real value already equals it -- and every arm ALSO asserts the result DIFFERS from the original, so no arm is vacuous. The sole literal is __LINE__'s 4242, which no genuine line number in this ~120-line file can produce. ★ RED-ON-DISABLE BY CONSTRUCTION: before this row every directive here was a hard P_PreprocessorPredefinedMacro error, so the file did not COMPILE -- restoring the refusal breaks the build rather than shifting the score. Fold-resistant: every compared value arrives through a function ARGUMENT, so the release arm proves the redefined values survive inlining and the full optimizer. exit = 1 + 2 + 4 + 8 + 16 + 32 + 64 + 128 = 255.
